author: hoschu
frame_panel_review_notes: Inspect attempt 000001 finds four connected components. Component 2 is the complete solid four-panel leaf, including its outer decorative border; components 0, 1 and 3 are localized at the lever/plate. No independent fixed frame or opening remains to assign to Frame. The apparent frame in the remote viewer was part of the leaf, not a separable jamb.
license_scope_review_notes: The actual page and download modal show CC Attribution linking CC BY 4.0.
custom_terms_review_notes: The description says “static door”; no additional author terms or separately credited texture source appear on the reviewed page.
duplicate_review_notes: Unique source identity; local inspect fingerprint f4ee27522e3b6b39d65ad3396fcfaa17ac37e2ef5b8be9a1855f37d4c000ed1a differs from all five accepted fingerprints.
local_dependency_review_notes: USDZ embeds scene.usdc and five 1K maps, with no external converted dependency. Embedded author, CC-BY-4.0 and source URL metadata match the reviewed page; no separate map terms were found.
local_duplicate_review_notes: Inspect attempt 000001 reports 1577 triangles, four components and fingerprint f4ee27522e3b6b39d65ad3396fcfaa17ac37e2ef5b8be9a1855f37d4c000ed1a; all five accepted fingerprints differ.
